description_blocks.text:
Generic 3.5-inch SATA drive reference from the FreeCAD Parts Library, not a manufacturer product. Model by Артём, licensed CC-BY-3.0; unchanged source geometry. Verify fit against the chosen drive before designing a printed tray or enclosure.

Community geometry by Артём, not a manufacturer model or a certification of any particular drive. The source model body is 147 x 102 x 26.1 mm (length x width x height); these are model dimensions, not universal form-factor limits. Mounting holes, SATA connector position, cable bend space and operating clearances must be verified against the chosen physical drive and its manufacturer drawing. Model geometry is retained unchanged; CC-BY-3.0 attribution and the source asset license accompany it. Its 102 mm model width must not be read as the standard width or a fit guarantee. The source FCStd metadata says All rights reserved, while the reviewed repository LICENSE-Assets explicitly covers this exported STEP under CC-BY-3.0; that repository license is the recorded license evidence.
